text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find out where and why the problem happens. Debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, can help you watch your code closely. It is also wise to follow a systematic approach: check one small part at a time instead of changing everything at once. Good logging is another useful strategy. By writing clear log messages, you can track what your program is doing and spot errors more easily. With patience and practice, debugging becomes much less stressful.
